title: Korean Vin Santo Hwajeon
description: A fusion dessert combining Korean hwajeon with Italian Vin Santo. Crunchy rice flour pancakes served with caramelized Korean honey and an Italian dessert wine reduction.
instructions: Combine rice flour and water in a bowl to form a smooth batter.
Heat coconut oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat.
Using a ladle, pour the batter into the pan to form pancakes.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
In a small saucepan, heat the Korean honey over low heat until caramelized.
To serve, place a pancake on a plate and drizzle with caramelized honey and Vin Santo reduction.
To make the reduction, boil Vin Santo in a saucepan until reduced by half.
Serve the hwajeon with the Vin Santo reduction immediately.
